research_question: Which mechanism, data condition, or compute bottleneck prevents one Elendril learner from selecting cost-effective cognitive actions and generalizing to new evidence? What is the smallest verified path toward memory and continual learning?
single_primary_endpoint: Mean full-episode utility = terminal accuracy - 0.1 * verified queries; exact EOS mandatory. Declare model inference cost as a separate Pareto dimension, not free.
primary_acceptance: Before looking at confirmation: >=0.90 complete-episode accuracy, >=0.80 by each public state kind, zero invalid actions, <=0.05 excess requests per episode versus fixed control, across both seeds. A candidate beating CE requires >=0.05 per-episode utility in both screen seeds and no >5pp subgroup regression.

data.rule: unique generated latent worlds; no padding/repeated filler; manifest world/generator/template/split hashes; new disjoint evaluation generator; do not claim language pretraining
data.no_test_leak: frozen confirmation generator/splits before screening; task/event/prompt/window and near-duplicate audits

compute.runtime_assumptions: actual GPU/driver/quota/session must be observed; two T4 memory spaces not pooled

arms.method: fixed policy; always-query; never-query; random; oracle separate
CE AdamW, uniform exposure, established V5 core
action-weighted CE, identical examples and exposure
uncertainty-first curriculum; equal full-epoch row multiset
independent alias/template augmentation; same budget and audit
learned decision or evidence-seeking regularizer; explicit objective and baseline
best two preregistered S3 competitors, new seeds and sealed generator

panels.name: Positive-control learnability
panels.hypothesis: Can a neural model fit explicit QUERY+EOS before OOD tests?
panels.metrics: train loss; exact content+EOS; invalid tokens
panels.gate: Always run; training prompts and distinct validation shown

panels.name: Known-evidence answering
panels.hypothesis: Does it answer immediately when evidence is sufficient?
panels.gate: Always after P01; matched seen/unseen worlds

panels.name: Missing-evidence query
panels.hypothesis: Does it request useful evidence when facts are missing?

panels.name: Conflicting-evidence query
panels.hypothesis: Does it avoid unsafe answers under unresolved conflicts?
panels.metrics: query rate; wrong-answer rate; later resolution

panels.name: Null and unavailable abstention
panels.hypothesis: Does it distinguish explicit null vs unavailable evidence?

panels.name: Post-query revision
panels.hypothesis: Can it incorporate a newly received observation and change its answer?

panels.name: Cost-aware thinking and queries
panels.hypothesis: Is it better than always-query, never-query and fixed?

panels.name: Uncertainty and self-error detection
panels.hypothesis: Does pre-outcome confidence predict error on novel worlds?
panels.metrics: Brier; ECE; AUROC; accuracy/coverage; extra cost
panels.gate: Diagnostic only; fitting/calibration uses separate validation

panels.name: Legal action and EOS integrity
panels.hypothesis: Does it emit parseable actions and terminate exactly?

panels.name: Query swap and query blindness
panels.hypothesis: Does answer causally follow query, not a constant shortcut?

panels.name: Temporal/recency shortcuts
panels.hypothesis: Does it respect timestamps and provenance over text order?

panels.name: Representation and distractor OOD
panels.hypothesis: Does performance survive aliases, separators, new templates and distractors?
panels.metrics: separate/joint OOD accuracy; loss; failure clusters
panels.gate: Always; independent generator; do not train on sealed variants

panels.name: Compositional reasoning 2→3 hop
panels.hypothesis: Does the learned core generalize beyond action tokens and 2-hop joins?
panels.gate: Conditional on qualified route/graph task; otherwise NOT_QUALIFIED

panels.name: Frozen-weight memory benefit
panels.hypothesis: Can admitted memory improve new episodes without a weight update?
panels.metrics: memory on/off; retrieval choice; cost; causal swaps
panels.gate: Conditional on available compatible learned or frozen model; provenance separate

panels.name: Sequential retention and transfer
panels.hypothesis: Does A survive B, and does B accelerate unseen C at equal total work?
panels.metrics: A-before/after; B; C curves; total GPU work
panels.gate: Conditional on independently qualified A and B; otherwise NOT_QUALIFIED

stages.name: source/data/scorer/canary qualification
stages.stop: any pin or GPU, data contamination, scorer, checkpoint restore, CUDA overfit failure

stages.name: cheap matched screen S3
stages.stop: positive control fails; no minimum formation; budget exhausted

stages.name: best S3 candidates independent seeds
stages.stop: no stable utility gain; subgroup regression

stages.name: conditional S8/S20 scaling probes
stages.stop: not enough time/VRAM, poor smaller-scale signal, throughput loss

stages.name: full 15 diagnostic panels, independent rescore, charts, ZIP
stages.stop: reserve export time; record NOT_QUALIFIED, FAILED, SKIPPED with cause

artifacts.requirements: every arm has declared status, reason, time, RNG, source/data/model/optimizer/tokenizer hashes; preserve failed and partial

no_claims: passing canary is not learned cognition
successful narrow synthetic panels are not AGI
developer chosen intervention is not autonomous self-improvement
15 panels are not 15 independently replicated discoveries
